description: A C# console app calls an asm shared library through P/Invoke: the portable build carries the library for every RID, dotnet run loads this machine's, and a RID-specific publish puts it next to the app, which runs from there.

steps.description: Builds the library for all eight RIDs and the app, whose output gets each RID's library under runtimes/.
Runs the app: .NET loads this machine's library from runtimes/.
Publishes for this machine: the library lands next to the app, flat.
Runs the published app through its apphost.
